scenes.title: Three more each time
scenes.problem: Three more each time: the outputs at positions 1, 2, 3, 4 are 5, 7, 9, 11. Write one algebraic rule T(n) for the value at position n. Verify it at position 4.
actions: Align positions 1, 2, 3, 4 above outputs 5, 7, 9, 11.
Calculate adjacent differences. Every change is 2; this is the coefficient of n.
Use position one: 5 = 2 × 1 + b, so the fixed part b is 3.
Write T(n) = 2n + 3. Substitute n=4 and check that the result is 11.
scenes.memo: T(n) = 2n + 3. At n=1, T(1)=5; at n=4, T(4)=11. Count the first term as 5; two new pieces are added for every new position.
scenes.misconception: A rule matched only one adjacent pair rather than all known positions.
